answer: Require each agent to stake a jade-token bond that vests slowly, like a grove maturing over seasons: a new identity pays the full stake up front and earns it back only after weeks of honest attestations. At dawn of each epoch the bond is slashed if the agent is caught duplicating work, so an attacker spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand stakes and wait weeks before any of them pays — the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not.
